doc: A preconnected set is one where there is no non-trivial open partition.
statement: {α : Type u} → [TopologicalSpace α] → Set α → Prop

doc: A connected set is one that is nonempty and where there is no non-trivial open partition.
statement: {α : Type u} → [TopologicalSpace α] → Set α → Prop
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsConnected s → s.Nonempty
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsConnected s → IsPreconnected s
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsPreirreducible s → IsPreconnected s
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsIrreducible s → IsConnected s
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α], IsPreconnected ∅
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, IsConnected {x}
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, IsPreconnected {x}
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, s.Subsingleton → IsPreconnected s

doc:
If any point of a set is joined to a fixed point by a preconnected subset,
then the original set is preconnected as well.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} (x : α),
  (∀ y ∈ s, ∃ t ⊆ s, x ∈ t ∧ y ∈ t ∧ IsPreconnected t) → IsPreconnected s

doc:
If any two points of a set are contained in a preconnected subset,
then the original set is preconnected as well.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α},
  (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, ∃ t ⊆ s, x ∈ t ∧ y ∈ t ∧ IsPreconnected t) → IsPreconnected s

doc: A union of a family of preconnected sets with a common point is preconnected as well.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] (x : α) (c : Set (Set α)),
  (∀ s ∈ c, x ∈ s) → (∀ s ∈ c, IsPreconnected s) → IsPreconnected (⋃₀ c)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Sort u_3} {s : ι → Set α},
  (⋂ i, s i).Nonempty → (∀ (i : ι), IsPreconnected (s i)) → IsPreconnected (⋃ i, s i)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] (x : α) {s t : Set α},
  x ∈ s → x ∈ t → IsPreconnected s → IsPreconnected t → IsPreconnected (s ∪ t)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s t : Set α},
  (s ∩ t).Nonempty → IsPreconnected s → IsPreconnected t → IsPreconnected (s ∪ t)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s t : Set α},
  (s ∩ t).Nonempty → IsConnected s → IsConnected t → IsConnected (s ∪ t)

doc: The directed sUnion of a set S of preconnected subsets is preconnected.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {S : Set (Set α)},
  DirectedOn (fun x1 x2 => x1 ⊆ x2) S → (∀ s ∈ S, IsPreconnected s) → IsPreconnected (⋃₀ S)

doc:
The biUnion of a family of preconnected sets is preconnected if the graph determined by
whether two sets intersect is preconnected.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Type u_3} {t : Set ι} {s : ι → Set α},
  (∀ i ∈ t, IsPreconnected (s i)) →
    (∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j => (s i ∩ s j).Nonempty ∧ i ∈ t) i j) →
      IsPreconnected (⋃ n ∈ t, s n)

doc:
The biUnion of a family of preconnected sets is preconnected if the graph determined by
whether two sets intersect is preconnected.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Type u_3} {t : Set ι} {s : ι → Set α},
  t.Nonempty →
    (∀ i ∈ t, IsConnected (s i)) →
      (∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j => (s i ∩ s j).Nonempty ∧ i ∈ t) i j) →
        IsConnected (⋃ n ∈ t, s n)

doc:
Preconnectedness of the iUnion of a family of preconnected sets
indexed by the vertices of a preconnected graph,
where two vertices are joined when the corresponding sets intersect.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Type u_3} {s : ι → Set α},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsPreconnected (s i)) →
    (∀ (i j : ι), Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j => (s i ∩ s j).Nonempty) i j) → IsPreconnected (⋃ n, s n)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Type u_3} [Nonempty ι] {s : ι → Set α},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsConnected (s i)) →
    (∀ (i j : ι), Relation.ReflTransGen (fun i j => (s i ∩ s j).Nonempty) i j) → IsConnected (⋃ n, s n)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {ι : Type u_3} {s : ι → Set α},
  IsPreconnected (⋃ n, s n) →
    (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (s i)) →
      ∀ (i j : ι), (s i).Nonempty → (s j).Nonempty → Relation.TransGen (fun a b => (s a ∩ s b).Nonempty) i j

doc:
The iUnion of connected sets indexed by a type with an archimedean successor (like `ℕ` or `ℤ`)
such that any two neighboring sets meet is preconnected.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] [inst_2 : SuccOrder β]
  [IsSuccArchimedean β] {s : β → Set α},
  (∀ (n : β), IsPreconnected (s n)) → (∀ (n : β), (s n ∩ s (Order.succ n)).Nonempty) → IsPreconnected (⋃ n, s n)

doc:
The iUnion of connected sets indexed by a type with an archimedean successor (like `ℕ` or `ℤ`)
such that any two neighboring sets meet is connected.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] [inst_2 : SuccOrder β]
  [IsSuccArchimedean β] [Nonempty β] {s : β → Set α},
  (∀ (n : β), IsConnected (s n)) → (∀ (n : β), (s n ∩ s (Order.succ n)).Nonempty) → IsConnected (⋃ n, s n)

doc:
The iUnion of preconnected sets indexed by a subset of a type with an archimedean successor
(like `ℕ` or `ℤ`) such that any two neighboring sets meet is preconnected.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] [inst_2 : SuccOrder β]
  [IsSuccArchimedean β] {s : β → Set α} {t : Set β},
  t.OrdConnected →
    (∀ n ∈ t, IsPreconnected (s n)) →
      (∀ n ∈ t, Order.succ n ∈ t → (s n ∩ s (Order.succ n)).Nonempty) → IsPreconnected (⋃ n ∈ t, s n)

doc:
The iUnion of connected sets indexed by a subset of a type with an archimedean successor
(like `ℕ` or `ℤ`) such that any two neighboring sets meet is preconnected.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder β] [inst_2 : SuccOrder β]
  [IsSuccArchimedean β] {s : β → Set α} {t : Set β},
  t.Nonempty →
    t.OrdConnected →
      (∀ n ∈ t, IsConnected (s n)) →
        (∀ n ∈ t, Order.succ n ∈ t → (s n ∩ s (Order.succ n)).Nonempty) → IsConnected (⋃ n ∈ t, s n)

doc:
Theorem of bark and tree: if a set is within a preconnected set and its closure, then it is
preconnected as well. See also `IsConnected.subset_closure`.
statement: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s t : Set α}, IsPreconnected s → s ⊆ t → t ⊆ closure s → IsPreconnected t

doc:
Theorem of bark and tree: if a set is within a connected set and its closure, then it is
connected as well. See also `IsPreconnected.subset_closure`.
statement: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s t : Set α}, IsConnected s → s ⊆ t → t ⊆ closure s → IsConnected t

doc: The closure of a preconnected set is preconnected as well.
statement: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsPreconnected s → IsPreconnected (closure s)

doc: The closure of a connected set is connected as well.
statement: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsConnected s → IsConnected (closure s)

doc: The image of a preconnected set is preconnected as well.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α},
  IsPreconnected s → ∀ (f : α → β), ContinuousOn f s → IsPreconnected (f '' s)

doc: The image of a connected set is connected as well.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α},
  IsConnected s → ∀ (f : α → β), ContinuousOn f s → IsConnected (f '' s)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α},
  IsPreconnected s ↔
    ∀ (t t' : Set α),
      IsClosed t → IsClosed t' → s ⊆ t ∪ t' → (s ∩ t).Nonempty → (s ∩ t').Nonempty → (s ∩ (t ∩ t')).Nonempty

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α} {f : α → β},
  Topology.IsInducing f → (IsPreconnected (f '' s) ↔ IsPreconnected s)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β} {s : Set β},
  IsPreconnected s → Function.Injective f → IsOpenMap f → s ⊆ Set.range f → IsPreconnected (f ⁻¹' s)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set β},
  IsPreconnected s → ∀ {f : α → β}, Function.Injective f → IsClosedMap f → s ⊆ Set.range f → IsPreconnected (f ⁻¹' s)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set β},
  IsConnected s → ∀ {f : α → β}, Function.Injective f → IsOpenMap f → s ⊆ Set.range f → IsConnected (f ⁻¹' s)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set β},
  IsConnected s → ∀ {f : α → β}, Function.Injective f → IsClosedMap f → s ⊆ Set.range f → IsConnected (f ⁻¹' s)

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s u v : Set α},
  IsOpen u → IsOpen v → Disjoint u v → s ⊆ u ∪ v → IsPreconnected s → s ⊆ u ∨ s ⊆ v

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} [inst_1 : LinearOrder β]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace β] [OrderClosedTopology β] {f : α → β} {b : β},
  IsPreconnected s → ContinuousOn f s → (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ b) → Set.MapsTo f s (Set.Ioi b) ∨ Set.MapsTo f s (Set.Iio b)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} [inst_1 : LinearOrder β]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace β] [OrderClosedTopology β] {f : α → β} {b : β},
  IsPreconnected s → ContinuousOn f s → (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ b) → (∃ x ∈ s, b < f x) → ∀ {x : α}, x ∈ s → b < f x

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} [inst_1 : LinearOrder β]
  [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace β] [OrderClosedTopology β] {f : α → β} {b : β},
  IsPreconnected s → ContinuousOn f s → (∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ b) → (∃ x ∈ s, f x < b) → ∀ {x : α}, x ∈ s → f x < b

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s u v : Set α},
  IsOpen u → IsOpen v → Disjoint u v → s ⊆ u ∪ v → (s ∩ u).Nonempty → IsPreconnected s → s ⊆ u

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s u v : Set α},
  IsOpen u → IsOpen v → Disjoint u v → s ⊆ u ∪ v → (s ∩ v).Nonempty → IsPreconnected s → s ⊆ v

doc:
If a preconnected set `s` intersects an open set `u`, and limit points of `u` inside `s` are
contained in `u`, then the whole set `s` is contained in `u`.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s u : Set α},
  IsPreconnected s → IsOpen u → (s ∩ u).Nonempty → closure u ∩ s ⊆ u → s ⊆ u

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α} {t : Set β},
  IsPreconnected s → IsPreconnected t → IsPreconnected (s ×ˢ t)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {s : Set α} {t : Set β},
  IsConnected s → IsConnected t → IsConnected (s ×ˢ t)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] {s : (i : ι) → Set (X i)},
  (∀ (i : ι), IsPreconnected (s i)) → IsPreconnected (Set.univ.pi s)

∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] {s : (i : ι) → Set (X i)},
  IsConnected (Set.univ.pi s) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), IsConnected (s i)

doc:
The connected component of a point is the maximal connected set
that contains this point.
statement: {α : Type u} → [TopologicalSpace α] → α → Set α

doc:
Given a set `F` in a topological space `α` and a point `x : α`, the connected
component of `x` in `F` is the connected component of `x` in the subtype `F` seen as
a set in `α`. This definition does not make sense if `x` is not in `F` so we return the
empty set in this case.
statement: {α : Type u} → [TopologicalSpace α] → Set α → α → Set α

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {F : Set α} {x : α} (h : x ∈ F),
  connectedComponentIn F x = Subtype.val '' connectedComponent ⟨x, h⟩
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {F : Set α} {x : α}, x ∉ F → connectedComponentIn F x = ∅
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, x ∈ connectedComponent x
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α} {F : Set α}, x ∈ F → x ∈ connectedComponentIn F x
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, (connectedComponent x).Nonempty
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α} {F : Set α}, (connectedComponentIn F x).Nonempty ↔ x ∈ F
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] (F : Set α) (x : α), connectedComponentIn F x ⊆ F
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, IsPreconnected (connectedComponent x)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α} {F : Set α}, IsPreconnected (connectedComponentIn F x)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, IsConnected (connectedComponent x)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α} {F : Set α}, IsConnected (connectedComponentIn F x) ↔ x ∈ F
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α} {s : Set α}, IsPreconnected s → x ∈ s → s ⊆ connectedComponent x

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} {x : α} {F : Set α},
  IsPreconnected s → x ∈ s → s ⊆ F → s ⊆ connectedComponentIn F x
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α} {s : Set α}, IsConnected s → x ∈ s → s ⊆ connectedComponent x
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α} {F : Set α}, IsPreconnected F → x ∈ F → connectedComponentIn F x = F

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x y : α},
  y ∈ connectedComponent x → connectedComponent x = connectedComponent y

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x y : α},
  connectedComponent x = connectedComponent y ↔ x ∈ connectedComponent y

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x y : α} {F : Set α},
  y ∈ connectedComponentIn F x → connectedComponentIn F x = connectedComponentIn F y
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] (x : α), connectedComponentIn Set.univ x = connectedComponent x

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x y : α},
  connectedComponent x ≠ connectedComponent y → Disjoint (connectedComponent x) (connectedComponent y)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, IsClosed (connectedComponent x)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β},
  Continuous f → ∀ (a : α), f '' connectedComponent a ⊆ connectedComponent (f a)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β} {s : Set α} {a : α},
  ContinuousOn f s → a ∈ s → f '' connectedComponentIn s a ⊆ connectedComponentIn (f '' s) (f a)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β},
  Continuous f → ∀ (a : α), Set.MapsTo f (connectedComponent a) (connectedComponent (f a))

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β} {s : Set α},
  ContinuousOn f s → ∀ {a : α}, a ∈ s → Set.MapsTo f (connectedComponentIn s a) (connectedComponentIn (f '' s) (f a))

doc:
The connected component of `(x, y)` in the product space is the product of the connected
components of `x` and `y`.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] (x : α) (y : β),
  connectedComponent (x, y) = connectedComponent x ×ˢ connectedComponent y

doc:
The connected component of `x` in a product space is the product of the connected components
of its coordinates.
statement:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {X : ι → Type u_2} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (X i)] (x : (i : ι) → X i),
  connectedComponent x = Set.univ.pi fun i => connectedComponent (x i)
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {x : α}, irreducibleComponent x ⊆ connectedComponent x

∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] (x : α) {F G : Set α},
  F ⊆ G → connectedComponentIn F x ⊆ connectedComponentIn G x

doc:
The preimage of a connected component of `F` is the union of the connected components of
`f ⁻¹' F` at the points of that preimage.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β} {F : Set β},
  ContinuousOn f (f ⁻¹' F) →
    ∀ (y : β), f ⁻¹' connectedComponentIn F y = ⋃ x ∈ f ⁻¹' connectedComponentIn F y, connectedComponentIn (f ⁻¹' F) x

doc:
The preimage of a connected component is the union of the connected components at the points
of that preimage.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β},
  Continuous f → ∀ (y : β), f ⁻¹' connectedComponent y = ⋃ x ∈ f ⁻¹' connectedComponent y, connectedComponent x

doc: A preconnected space is one where there is no non-trivial open partition.
statement: (α : Type u) → [TopologicalSpace α] → Prop
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α], IsPreconnected Set.univ → PreconnectedSpace α

doc: The universal set `Set.univ` in a preconnected space is a preconnected set.
statement: ∀ {α : Type u} {inst : TopologicalSpace α} [self : PreconnectedSpace α], IsPreconnected Set.univ

doc: A connected space is a nonempty one where there is no non-trivial open partition.
statement: (α : Type u) → [TopologicalSpace α] → Prop
∀ (α : Type u) [inst : TopologicalSpace α], ConnectedSpace α ↔ PreconnectedSpace α ∧ Nonempty α
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [toPreconnectedSpace : PreconnectedSpace α], Nonempty α → ConnectedSpace α
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [ConnectedSpace α], IsConnected Set.univ
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α], PreconnectedSpace α ↔ IsPreconnected Set.univ
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α], ConnectedSpace α ↔ IsConnected Set.univ

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] [PreconnectedSpace α] {f : α → β},
  Continuous f → IsPreconnected (Set.range f)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] [ConnectedSpace α] {f : α → β},
  Continuous f → IsConnected (Set.range f)

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [ConnectedSpace α] [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace β] {f : α → β},
  Function.Surjective f → Continuous f → ConnectedSpace β

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] (e : α ≃ₜ β),
  ConnectedSpace α ↔ ConnectedSpace β

∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] [PreconnectedSpace α] {f : α → β},
  DenseRange f → Continuous f → PreconnectedSpace β
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α], ConnectedSpace α ↔ ∃ x, connectedComponent x = Set.univ
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α], PreconnectedSpace α ↔ ∀ (x : α), connectedComponent x = Set.univ
∀ {X : Type u_3} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [h : PreconnectedSpace X] (x : X), connectedComponent x = Set.univ
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsPreconnected s → PreconnectedSpace ↑s
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsConnected s → ConnectedSpace ↑s
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsPreconnected s ↔ PreconnectedSpace ↑s
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α}, IsConnected s ↔ ConnectedSpace ↑s
